comment: The section appropriately places claims engines and scheme-administration platforms outside DPI-H, but the boundary between authoritative benefit definitions and executable adjudication rules is not fully explicit.

anchor.note: p.39-40 l.Lines 520-526 read as the printed page; section 2.4.2 agrees

public.text: The section appropriately places claims engines and scheme-administration platforms outside DPI-H, but the boundary between authoritative benefit definitions and executable adjudication rules is not fully explicit.
public.suggestedRevision: State that the Benefits Package Registry publishes authoritative definitions and machine-readable rules where appropriate, while operational systems execute enrolment, authorisation, adjudication, contracting, and payment workflows.
